date_inferred_from: Entered on leaves 382 verso and 383, between the headings of the sittings of 30 October 1781 (leaf 381) and 22 November 1781 (leaf 396). The heading of its own sitting is on a page not among the scans.

translation.en:
On behalf of the Illustrious Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, against the Illustrious Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — a Report

Let there be seen at this place a Report on behalf of the Illustrious Stanisław Ścibor Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, against the Illustrious Magnificent Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — for the Ordinary General Sessions of the Crown Tribunal of the Kingdom at Piotrków — as the copy in the submitted documents [attests].

text_english:
On behalf of the Illustrious Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, against the Illustrious Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — a Report

Let there be seen at this place a Report on behalf of the Illustrious Stanisław Ścibor Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, against the Illustrious Magnificent Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — for the Ordinary General Sessions of the Crown Tribunal of the Kingdom at Piotrków — as the copy in the submitted documents [attests].
summary_en: In 1781 Stanisław Ścibor Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa and owner of Łukom, obtained a citation before the Crown Tribunal at Piotrków against Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice and owner of Trąbczyn; the report of it was entered at Konin.
summary_de: Registervermerk von 1781: Bericht über die Ladung, die Stanisław Ścibor Chełmski, Schatzmeister von Wschowa, gegen Antoni Prusimski, Starost von Niszczewice, vor das Krontribunal in Petrikau erwirkt hat.
